In Xcode, select File > Add Package Dependencies…
Click Add Local… and choose <PROJECT_ROOT>/DebugTools/IOSDebugKit.
Add the IOSDebugKit product only to a dedicated Debug app target; keep every Release or production target free of this package dependency.
Add <PROJECT_ROOT>/DebugTools/IOSDebugBootstrap.swift only to the dedicated Debug app target, call try await IOSDebugBootstrap.start() at Debug startup, and call await IOSDebugBootstrap.stop() later at shutdown.
